name: u_listreduce
notes: The documented sum example reduces1+2+3+4 to10, and bang repeats. It applies the operator to pairs[1,2], [3,3], [6,4]. Inlet1 is intentionally absent from timed stimuli because a real + Pd feedback fixture returns each pair sum synchronously. Right-outlet order is not asserted since recursive connection order can reverse console observation, but six bounded two-number operations must occur.
